items.title: 56679_Arthur Briggs oral history interview
items.q: And I formed another orchestra, five pieces for the Murray's Club. We had two of the Syncopated Orchestra, and -- three of the Syncopated Orchestra, with Salnave

ctx.x: We went to Oslo for three months and after the three months we came back, we went back to London, and then the band, we folded then.

And I formed another orchestra, five pieces for the Murray's Club. We had two of the Syncopated Orchestra, and -- three of the Syncopated Orchestra, with Salnave, the flutist, who was then a saxophone player. He bought a saxophone, --
And we played at the Murray's Club. We had taken an African piano player by the name of Caleb Quaye, he called himself, Mope Desmond.
